answer: No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. The dune says who, the echo says how much, the mirror says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Pewter caster brass mark poured at the turning shop, the mark is each brass is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer, and the panel accepts nothing else. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 205 masks, 38335 POA, gone on one grade.
